label: First laser works
detail: Theodore Maiman and Irnee d'Haenens see laser action from a ruby crystal at Hughes Research Laboratories.

label: Argon-ion laser first seen
detail: William Bridges observes argon-ion lasing at Hughes; krypton lines follow that July. These gas lasers make colored shows possible.

label: Rockne Krebs shows laser sculpture
detail: "Sculpture Minus Object" in Washington uses red beams, fog and mirrors. Other accounts date his first laser work to 1968.

label: Audio/Video/Laser at Mills College
detail: Lowell Cross, David Tudor and Carson Jeffries stage what Cross calls the first multi-color laser light show with x-y scanning.

label: Pepsi Pavilion opens at Expo '70
detail: A four-color krypton laser system by Cross and Jeffries runs in Osaka; Cross gives the dedication date as March 15.

label: Laserium opens at Griffith Observatory
detail: Ivan Dryer's live-played laser show begins a trial run in Los Angeles and stays 28 years.

label: Led Zeppelin photographed with lasers
detail: Three beams at Nassau Coliseum, New York - the earliest dated evidence of lasers at a rock show.

label: The Who's argon laser at Leicester
detail: A 4 W argon laser fanned through a diffraction grating at Granby Halls.

label: Lovelight, the first automated show
detail: A planetarium laser show run from stored images and recorded control tracks, with no live player.

label: Time reports FDA inspectors at light shows
detail: The Bureau of Radiological Health had told Blue Oyster Cult to adjust its show and halted a preview on the Mall in Washington.

label: Jarre plays the laser harp in China
detail: Five concerts in Beijing and Shanghai, on a harp ordered from Bernard Szajner; 218,000 attended by the artist's figure.

label: Stone Mountain laser show opens
detail: The Georgia park's mountain-side show begins; the park estimated 20 million viewers in its first 25 years.

label: Rendez-vous Houston
detail: Jarre uses downtown skyscrapers as screens; attendance is estimated at 1.3 million or 1.5 million.

label: ILDA founded
detail: The International Laser Display Association holds its first organizational meeting at Lake Tahoe, Nevada.

label: Last Laserium show at Griffith
detail: "Laser Visions" plays to a sold-out dome; the observatory's timeline gives January 6, the day the building closed.
